input.subject: Cancellation - workspace HG-2291 (UGC Studio) before the Studio plan starts
input.body:
Hello,

Harmony Games is cancelling workspace HG-2291 (UGC Studio). Please end it when the pilot ends on Oct 15, 2025, and do not start the Studio plan ($1,800/month) on Oct 16. We don't want any charges on this workspace.

Please confirm the cancellation in writing.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the pilot, the videos were useful. We're holding off on new spend for the rest of the year, so we won't be carrying on after the pilot. Please don't line up another brief. I've also sent the written cancellation to billing@paylane.io so the Studio plan doesn't start on Oct 16.

Thanks again,
Frederick

Hi Maren,

Thanks for the call and the order form. We're holding off on new spend for the rest of the year, so please don't set up Pro for Nov 1. We'll stay on the free seat for now.

Thanks again,
Frederick

Hi Sven,

Thanks for the proposal and for checking in. We're holding off on new spend for the rest of the year, and that includes travel, so we won't be doing the Seattle Indie Expo push on Nov 7. Please don't book any flights or hotel for us.

Thanks for thinking of us,
Frederick

Hi Kofi,

Thanks for the proposal. We're holding off on new spend for the rest of the year, so we won't be booking the November creator campaign. Please don't pencil in a slot for us.

Thanks again,
Frederick

Hi Rina,

Thanks for the invitation and for taking the call with Robert. We're holding off on new spend for the rest of the year, so we won't be taking a stand at the Spotlight Fest showcase on Dec 5.

Thanks for thinking of us,
Frederick

Hi Mila,

Yes, please keep the nightly database backups running. We're staying with Vaultline on Standard ($19/month) from the Oct 12 renewal.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Jonas,

Confirmed. We're staying, so please renew and reissue the SSL certificate for our game API domain before it expires on Oct 20 ($89 for the year).

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the heads-up. We're staying with Pingwise, so please move us to Team ($29/month) from Nov 1 as planned and keep phone and SMS paging running for our on-call rota. Please don't downgrade us to the free plan.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Aiden,

Thanks, and sorry for the slow reply. Only Leonard or Arthur can sign agreements for Harmony Games, and with a 36-month term the program agreement goes to our lawyers first. It's with them now, and then with Leonard or Arthur to sign. We'll aim to come back to you before the cohort closes on Oct 31.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Noor,

Thanks for the LOI and your patience. Because it includes exclusivity for Japan and Korea, it goes to our lawyers for review first, and then to Leonard or Arthur to sign. It's with them now, and we'll aim to come back to you before your Oct 20 deadline.

Thanks,
Frederick

Thanks, we're interested. Because the participation agreement includes a licence to use Domino Delights' name and art, it goes to our lawyers first, and then to Leonard or Arthur to sign. It's with them now, and we'll aim to come back to you before submissions close on Nov 1.

Thanks,
Frederick

Thanks for the nudge. Only an officer can accept agreements for Harmony Games, so the featuring agreement in your partner portal is with Leonard or Arthur to accept. We'll aim to get it done before the Oct 24 cut-off.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Iris,

Happy to. We'll use our lawyers' mutual NDA template, and it's with Leonard or Arthur to sign. We'll aim to get it to you signed before our Oct 8 call.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Leah,

Yes, please keep the setup on hold. Only an officer can accept terms for Harmony Games, so accepting the dashboard terms for the free tier is with Leonard or Arthur. We'll let you know once it's done.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the quote and for checking in. We're not ordering anything this quarter, so we'll pick the font licence up in January, while your quote is still valid (until Jan 31).

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Nadia,

Thanks for the invite. We're heads-down this quarter, so we'll pass on a feedback call for now and pick Quillcraft up again in January, before pricing starts in February.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Hana,

Thanks for offering the walkthrough. We're not taking on anything new this quarter, so we'll pick Reviewly up in January. Please make sure nothing moves us onto a paid plan when the free trial ends.

input.body:
Hi Leonard,

The vendor and partner backlog is done. Everyone who was waiting has a written answer, everything is logged in "Q4 commitments log" in the Q4 commitments folder (shared with you), and each company's contact is in Contacts.

What we're keeping (all on Arthur's keep-running list, all told we're staying):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups. Starter is retired, so it moves to Standard at $19/month from the Oct 12 renewal.
- Certwell: SSL cert for the API domain, $89/year, renews before it lapses on Oct 20.
- Pingwise: the night pager. Moves to Team at $29/month from Nov 1 so phone/SMS paging keeps working.

Waiting on you or Arthur to sign (all six are cards on the Harmony Games board's To Do list):
- Kinetic Arcade: Zombie Match 3D publishing LOI for Japan/Korea. It has 12 months' exclusivity, so ESG reviews it first. Needed by Oct 20.
- Lumencloud: Startup Program agreement for $25k credits. It's a 36-month term, so ESG reviews it first. Needed by Oct 31.
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle participation agreement, which licenses Domino Delights' name and art. ESG reviews it first. Needed by Nov 1.
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template, so no review needed. Needed before the Oct 8 call.
- Orbit Store: featuring agreement, accepted in their partner portal by an officer. No fees. Needed by Oct 24.
- Markward: free-tier brand monitoring with click-through terms in their dashboard. No date given.

The three ESG ones went to ESG Law intake, one email each, with you and Arthur cc'd.

Everything else, for reference:
- Ended (would cost cash before Jan 1), each told no: Brightlane retainer, the ASO retainer, store listing localization, the player panel, the Bay Area Indie Showcase booth, the trailer music licence, Framewell Pro, Seattle Indie Expo (the travel they'd book and bill us counts, per your Monday change), the November creator campaign, and the Spotlight Fest stand. The Clipforge UGC pilot would have rolled into $1,800/month on Oct 16, so the written cancellation has gone to billing@paylane.io as their notice requires.
- Parked for the Jan 5 review (13, each told we'll pick it up in January): fonts quote, Quillcraft, Reviewly, Loopnote, VO quote, Benchmarkly, Lanternfly, Tilecast, Echohall, Retainly, Cloudlark credits, Pressbeam and Hootline.
- Already answered: Motive Forge (Arthur passed on Sep 19), so nothing sent.

Thanks,
Fred
